description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Torentify is seeking a QA professional to support test planning, design, and execution. The role validates web applications and APIs, troubleshoots issues, and collaborates with product management, development teams, and clients to ensure software meets business needs.
Software Engineer, SQL, testing web applications, validating APIs and database data, and documenting defects

Responsibilities:
• Contribute independently to test design, test planning, and test execution
• Work within an Agile/Scrum team to support software quality throughout the development process
• Test web-based applications using browser developer tools
• Develop test plans, test cases, and other testing documentation
• Follow the defect management process and support issue tracking and resolution
• Work with product management and development teams to understand requirements and technical specifications
• Interact with clients to understand business scenarios and provide testing and troubleshooting support
• Validate API requests and responses using browser developer tools
• Write basic database queries to support testing and data validation
• Analyze problems, gather relevant information, establish facts, and draw sound conclusions
• Manage testing tasks and deliverables while meeting deadlines
• Collaborate with team members to troubleshoot technical issues and identify practical solutions

Requirements:
• 1–3 years of relevant QA technical experience
• Experience testing web-based applications and using browser developer tools
• Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies
• Experience preparing test plans, test cases, and related test artifacts
• Understanding of defect management processes
• Experience working with APIs and validating request and response data
• Ability to write basic database queries
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills
• Clear written and verbal communication
• Ability to work collaboratively, adapt to changing priorities, and meet deadlines

Preferred:
• A bachelor's degree (BS or BA) is preferred
• Knowledge of the health insurance domain is a strong plus
• Advanced SQL and relational database knowledge is a major plus
• Familiarity with performance testing concepts and tools is an advantage
• Experience working in a fast-paced startup environment is beneficial
• United States work authorization is preferred
